## 更新内容

- 新增 STEP 06「扩写改写」工作流，可从正文生成页带入当前小节，也支持在扩写页按目录多选、全选章节后批量扩写。
- 扩写设置新增目标总字数、并发数量、一致性审计、表格补充、Mermaid 图和 AI 生图数量等选项。
- 优化扩写任务进度展示，区分运行中、已完成、失败等状态，并在完成后提供返回上一步查看正文的入口。
- 增加章节内容预览能力，便于扩写前快速查看当前章节正文。
- 修复扩写进度可能超过总数的问题，并优化扩写后的配图规划逻辑。
- 优化 STEP 05/STEP 06 以及其他浮动工具条页面的底部安全留白，减少底部按钮遮挡内容的问题。
- 更新技术方案使用说明，补充扩写改写流程截图和说明。

## What's Changed

- Added the STEP 06 expansion and rewrite workflow, including entry from the current generated section and in-page outline-based multi-select / select-all expansion.
- Added expansion settings for target word count, concurrency, consistency audit, table enrichment, Mermaid diagrams, and AI image generation limits.
- Improved expansion task progress visibility with localized and color-coded running, success, and error states, plus a shortcut to return to the generated content view after completion.
- Added section content preview before running expansion.
- Fixed expansion progress counting so completed items no longer exceed the selected total, and refined illustration planning after expansion.
- Improved bottom safe spacing for STEP 05, STEP 06, and other pages that use the floating toolbar to prevent content from being covered.
- Updated the technical plan user guide with screenshots and instructions for the expansion workflow.

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/liwg1995/YuduBid/compare/v0.4.3...v0.4.4
